Remark
[formulas for the scalar curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0105 ↗ def:pet-ch3-scalar-curvature

In an orthonormal basis $e_1,\dots ,e_n$, \[ \operatorname {scal}=\sum _{j}g(\operatorname {Ric}(e_j),e_j) =\sum _{i,j}g(R(e_i,e_j)e_j,e_i)=\sum _{i,j}g(\mathfrak R(e_i\wedge e_j),e_i\wedge e_j) =2\sum _{i<j}g(\mathfrak R(e_i\wedge e_j),e_i\wedge e_j)=2\sum _{i<j}\sec (e_i,e_j). \] When $n=2$, $\operatorname {scal}(p)=2\sec (T_pM)$.
